pages.title: Please Return the Swallowed
pages.text: The native interaction lets you recover swallowed belongings.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A crocodile stores swallowed victim drops; feather interaction recovers them. Clock feeding is a separate native action. Guide wording suggests scaring pillagers, but no exact radius or guaranteed fear is asserted.
